results.title: 2026 Voter’s Guide - Florida House District 33
results.description: As part of our commitment to providing you with what you need to make an informed decision in the 2026 elections, News 6 joined with the News Collaborative of Central Florida to present the Voting Central Florida 2026 Voter’s Guide. Here are the candidates for Florida House District 33.

results.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians and Washington Post photographer in West Bank
results.description: The settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives and beat Heidi Levine, a veteran photojournalist. Witnesses said Israeli soldiers did nothing to halt the violence.

results.title: Katie Zacharia out as White House press secretary after less than a week
results.description: “Maybe it’s not for her,” President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday.
